instructions.name: buy_food
docs: Player burns Gems and gets `amount` meals of one food and tier added to their profile.

instructions.name: buy_gems
docs: Player pays SOL to the treasury and receives gems.

instructions.name: buy_item
docs: Player burns gems (fixed catalog price) and receives item units.

instructions.name: care
docs: Care strengthens bond and helps a well-rested Rebyter recover from bad conditions.

accounts.name: player_profile
docs: The player's profile: counts the action for today's quests.

instructions.name: claim_daily_ration
docs: Once per UTC day: adds the free ration (all four foods) to the player's profile.

instructions.name: claim_quest
docs: Claims the meals of one of today's quests once the program has counted
enough of the matching actions (feed, play, care, rest, train) today.

instructions.name: create_habitat
docs: Creates a habitat as its own 1/1 Token-2022 NFT. The layout (where the Rebyters and
objects stand) lives inside the NFT's metadata, so it travels with the habitat. A free
habitat type is the starter pack: claimable once per wallet, it also gives the first
meals. Other habitats cost Gems. The new habitat becomes the active one.

accounts.name: owner_gem_account
docs: Omit (null) for the free starter habitat.

accounts.name: mint
docs: single account that stores the habitat.

instructions.name: create_habitat_type
docs: Registers a habitat kind (no shared mint: every habitat is its own 1/1 NFT). A price of 0
is the starter habitat, which each wallet can claim once.

instructions.name: create_item_type
docs: Registers an item mint (created client-side, 0 decimals, mint authority =
economy PDA). Items are plain transferable tokens bought with Gems. A training machine
names the training it improves and its bonus (percent of the gains); an evolution item
names the evolution id it turns a Rebyter into. Plain items pass NO_MACHINE, 0 and 0.

instructions.name: create_rebyter
docs: Creates a 1/1 Token-2022 Rebyter whose complete persistent game
state lives inside the mint account's TokenMetadata extension.
No per-Rebyter PDA account is created. The only asset/state account is
the mint itself, matching Rebyters' single-account design.

accounts.name: rebyter_authority
docs: second Rebyter account. It exists solely to sign Token-2022 metadata CPIs.

accounts.name: mint
docs: transaction and is the single account that stores Rebyter state.

accounts.name: rule_set
docs: unified active atlas root verifies both forms and gameplay rules.

accounts.name: item_type
docs: Optional evolution item: type, mint and the wallet's token account. When given, one unit is
burnt and the item replaces the rule requirements (the path itself must still be in the atlas).

instructions.name: feed
docs: Feed with one of four food groups (0 meat, 1 plant, 2 fish, 3 fruit) and one of four
tiers (0 plain .. 3 feast). Uses up one meal of that food and tier from the profile.

accounts.name: player_profile
docs: The player's profile: counts the action for today's quests.

instructions.name: initialize_economy
docs: Creates the economy singleton. The gem mint is created client-side
(Token-2022, 0 decimals, NonTransferable, PermanentDelegate = economy
PDA, mint authority = economy PDA, no freeze authority) and validated here.

instructions.name: play
docs: Play builds bond and a little speed while consuming energy/fullness.

accounts.name: player_profile
docs: The player's profile: counts the action for today's quests.

instructions.name: rest
docs: Rest restores energy. It is not a cooldown: it is a player action and can
be used whenever desired, but it gives no stat farming advantage.

accounts.name: player_profile
docs: The player's profile: counts the action for today's quests.

instructions.name: select_habitat
docs: Chooses which habitat in the wallet is the one shown when the game opens.

instructions.name: set_food
docs: Sets the food economy: meals of each plain food in the daily ration (0 = off) and the Gem
price of one meal for every food (meat, plants, fish, fruit) and tier (index type * 4 + tier).

instructions.name: set_gem_pack
docs: Sets (or disables with zeros) a gem pack. Prices are in lamports.

instructions.name: set_habitat_layout
docs: Saves the layout inside the habitat NFT: which Rebyters stand where and where each
object is. Nothing here has economic value; what is *owned* is read from the wallet
when the habitat is shown.

accounts.name: item_type
docs: The kind of island this habitat is: it holds the limits.

instructions.name: train
docs: Train with one of six trainings:
0 power, 1 endurance, 2 defense, 3 speed, 4 combat, 5 balanced.
Everyone trains at the normal rate. A specialised machine of the matching training held in
the wallet (pass its item type and token account) adds its bonus to the gains.

accounts.name: item_type
docs: Optional: the type of the specialised machine the wallet holds (only the program creates these).

accounts.name: machine_account
docs: Optional: the wallet's token account of that machine.

fields.name: food_prices
docs: Gem price of one meal, index food type * 4 + tier.

fields.name: ration_units
docs: Meals of each food in the free daily ration; 0 = off.

fields.name: machine_training
docs: Training this item improves (0..6), or NO_MACHINE.

fields.name: machine_bonus
docs: Percent added to the gains of that training.

fields.name: evo_target
docs: Evolution id this item turns a Rebyter into (0 = not an evolution item).

fields.name: max_placed
docs: Habitats only: the most Rebyters and objects this kind of island can hold (0 for other items).

types.name: PlacedSlot
docs: A Rebyter in the habitat: its mint and tile.

types.name: PlayerProfile
docs: The one per-wallet account: pokedex discoveries, food counters and the small fixed-size daily
state (ration day, quest counters). Fixed fields come first; only `discoveries` ever grows.

fields.name: ration_day
docs: Game day of the last claimed ration (0 = never).

fields.name: quest_day
docs: Game day the counters below belong to.

fields.name: counts
docs: Actions done on `quest_day`: feed, play, care, rest, train (saturating).

fields.name: claimed
docs: Bit i set = quest slot i already claimed on `quest_day`.

fields.name: starter_claimed
docs: True once the starter habitat (and its first meals) was claimed.

fields.name: active_habitat
docs: The habitat NFT shown when the game opens (default key = none yet).

fields.name: food
docs: Meals in stock, index food type * 4 + tier (meat, plants, fish, fruit; plain to feast).

types.name: PropSlot
docs: An object in the habitat. Position and size are fixed-point (value * 1000), rotation is a
fraction of a turn in 1/65535.

fields.name: action
docs: 0 feed, 1 play, 2 care, 3 rest, 4 train.

fields.name: time_bucket
docs: 0 night, 1 morning, 2 day, 3 evening (UTC).
